plain_summary: Both runs read the settings helper and its tests. Early RL proposed six issues. Final RL returned one focused report, and both reports matched the known bug.
software_and_risk: A JavaScript helper updates nested settings. A flaw could let untrusted input change shared object settings and affect other code.
submitted_report_summary: Reported six possible issues, including unsafe changes to shared settings.
known_bug_checker_summary: The checker credited the shared-settings finding.
